title: access_request_answer
description: A recipient device answers. yes needs duration (one of request.durations): the hub opens the device until then (access_early, logged with the author); no may carry message. The first answer wins; a later one gets access_request_error {already_answered, request}. Only recipient devices of this request now (set_up_by, setup_devices with its kind, family manager for a babysitter) with access themselves; away through <ns>/family with effective remote access. Answer: access_request_update (closed); the requesting device gets access_request_state and client_config_updated, the other recipients access_request_update.
